# GitHub Copilot instructions

This repository's canonical instructions for **all** AI coding agents live in
[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Read it in full before making changes — it covers build/test commands,
architecture principles, state-tracking rules, code style, and the branching/PR workflow.

## Attribution

Follow the **Attribution policy** section of `AGENTS.md` exactly. In short: the only identity that
may ever be attributed as author, co-author, committer, contributor, reviewer, or release author is
`regalen <regalen@outlook.com>`. Never attribute GitHub Copilot, GitHub, Microsoft, or any other AI
agent, bot, model, or organisation — no `Co-authored-by:`/`Signed-off-by:` trailers, no
"AI-assisted" or "Generated by …" notes in commits, PRs, merges, tags, release notes, changelogs,
code comments, or generated documentation.
